profile.name: Meera
profile.bio: Product designer. Weekends belong to the Sahyadris, weeknights to books and filter coffee.

prompts.a: Sunrise trek to Sinhagad, misal after, long nap, balcony reading.
you plan the snacks for a trek without being asked.

C.sunday: A sunrise trek to Sinhagad with two friends, then a long misal breakfast. Afternoon nap, and I end the day reading on the balcony with filter coffee.
C.hill: Pineapple absolutely belongs on pizza. I will also defend dal chawal as the best comfort food on earth.
C.weirdly_good: I can parallel park a car in one go on the first try, and I can guess the exact time without looking at a clock.
C.laugh: My grandmother tried to send a voice note and recorded four minutes of her pressure cooker whistling instead.
C.place: Spiti Valley, because I want to see a sky with that many stars and spend a week somewhere without network.
C.friends_rely: Planning trips nobody else wants to plan, and being the calm one when things go wrong.

E.e1: haha thank you, yours made me smile too 😄
E.e2: mostly trekking or reading, sometimes cooking something ambitious that may or may not work haha
E.e4: omg yes, Sinhagad like twice a month. which one are you thinking?
E.e5: no worries at all, hope the day got better
E.e6: something low-key, like a walk and chai somewhere quiet where we can actually talk
E.e8: texting for sure, calls only for the important stuff

profile.name: Arjun
profile.bio: Backend engineer by day, biryani experimenter by night. Trying to get better at treks without complaining on the way up.

prompts.a: Board game nights beat clubbing, every single time.
Cook a big lunch for friends, then a long walk and a nap.

C.sunday: I cook a huge lunch for friends, usually some biryani experiment, then we go for a long walk by the river and I nap like I earned it.
C.hill: Board game nights beat clubbing. Also, filter coffee is overrated and cutting chai is the real deal.
C.weirdly_good: Remembering everyone's chai order after hearing it once, even at office parties with thirty people.
C.laugh: My cousin tried to teach my dad a dance trend for a reel and my dad ended up going viral instead of him.
C.place: Hampi, because I want to cycle around the ruins at sunrise and eat at every small stall on the way.
C.friends_rely: Hosting. If something needs to be celebrated, I am the one cooking for twelve people.

E.e1: Haha thanks, yours was way better though 😄
E.e2: Mostly cooking or losing at Catan with friends. Weekends are for food basically
E.e3: Yes, but only with jalapeños. Plain pineapple is too much yaar
E.e4: I have done a couple! Still slow on the climbs though. Which one?
E.e5: Arre no problem at all, hope it got better
E.e6: Good food and a long walk. Easy to talk that way
E.e8: Texting mostly, calls are for when the story is too long
